product.title: Reef Snorkeling in National Park from Cancun with Beachside Lunch

description.text: In Cancun, snorkel the Great Maya Reef on a half-day snorkeling tour of the coral reef near Puerto Morelos. Spot fish, marine wildlife, and vibrant corals as you swim alongside the snorkel guides, then enjoy some free time to explore the fishing village of Puerto Morelos. Stops include Puerto Morelos National Reef Park, Puerto Morelos. This snorkel tour includes all equipment, lunch at a beach club, and round-trip transport from centrally-located hotels in Cancun and the Riviera Maya. Ideal for visitors basing in Cancun who want a guided city experience without coordinating bus and walking routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Puerto Morelos National Reef Park, Puerto Morelos that define this Cancun sightseeing experience, with a guide handling hotel pickup, ruin tickets, and cenote or island pacing so the day stays focused on the outing rather than logistics.

highlights: Beach club access and lunch included
Choice of morning or afternoon departure
Small group tour limited to 14 people
Pickup and drop-off from your hotel in the area
